title: With Amader Pradakhep: Art and Kids Workshops · AquaTerra
description: AquaTerra's {count} workshops with Amader Pradakhep, {firstYear} to {lastYear}: art, music, science, games and festival sessions for children in Kolkata.
lede: AquaTerra has held {count} workshops with Amader Pradakhep between {firstYear} and {lastYear}, nearly all for children. Art and craft make up more than half of them, with music, science, games and health talks in between. The series has run across {years}, and the most recent workshop is the Christmas stocking session of 20 December 2025.

sections.heading: the 2024 series
body: The series starts on 7 June 2024 with Build You, a personality development workshop, and the next day brought Health Over Sugar, a diabetes awareness session for children. Through the summer came Art Lab on 21 June, Tile by Tile, a mosaic workshop on 5 July, and Colour Splash on 26 July. Autumn and winter held Musical Minds on 28 October, a Children's Day games workshop on 13 November, Science in Action on 29 November and Merry Masks, a paper mask and carol singing session, on 16 December.

sections.heading: the 2025 calendar
body: The 2025 workshops followed the calendar. Her Voice on 24 January was a women's empowerment session on rights and confidence. Paint the Planet on 1 March marked Earth Day with nature-themed art, and World Health Day on 5 April covered wellness, nutrition and hygiene. Tiny Prints, a fingerpainting workshop, came on 6 September, Mindful Marks made Diwali greeting cards on 15 October, and Stocking Decoration on 20 December had children making Christmas stockings while volunteers handed out cake.

sections.heading: why art leads
body: More than half of the workshops are art, craft or mosaic sessions: Art Lab, Tile by Tile, Colour Splash, Merry Masks, Paint the Planet, Tiny Prints, Mindful Marks and Stocking Decoration. In each of them the children make something of their own. For the wider range of art sessions across AquaTerra, see [Art and craft workshops](/impact/arts-and-crafts).

sections.heading: when the workshops happened
body: Friday and Saturday were the usual days, with six workshops on Friday and five on Saturday. The first two were on consecutive days, 7 and 8 June 2024, one on personality and one on diabetes awareness. Two Christmas workshops ran in December, Merry Masks in 2024 and Stocking Decoration in 2025, and the Diwali card session came in October 2025.

sections.heading: what the children did
body: The sessions aim at confidence and self-expression. Build You was about confidence, communication and social skills. Her Voice was a women's empowerment session on rights and confidence, Musical Minds explored rhythm, melody and creativity through songs and instruments, and Science in Action set out to show children the wonders of science. Health Over Sugar taught children about diabetes.

Tile by Tile was a mosaic session where children designed patterns with coloured pieces, and Art Lab let them explore their imagination through colour and design. Mindful Marks made Diwali greeting cards. At Stocking Decoration the children made their own Christmas stockings, and volunteers handed out cake.

sections.heading: volunteers on the day
body: Amader Pradakhep workshops have drawn {volunteers} volunteer turnouts across {count} drives. Most ran with a small team, and the biggest turnout was six, at the Children's Day games workshop on 13 November 2024. A student who went to several drives is counted once for each drive, so the total is turnouts, not separate people.

faqs.q: Can a teenager volunteer on an Amader Pradakhep art workshop?
faqs.a: AquaTerra's members are aged 14 to 19. To join, sign in with Google and wait for approval. Approved members then take part in drives like the art and craft workshops on this page.
